AS-cb6131f4ed8c.t: Arranged according to the fitness of each day, together with mystical selections, for the ease of the singers. Second printing. Vagharshapat, at the press of the Holy Catholicosate of Etchmiadzin, 1888 (Armenian year 1337), by command of His Holiness Makar, most glorious, of sanctified [?] life, Catholicos of All Armenians. Those who drank from the streams of the Spirit, and in successive times sang the melodious songs of the Sharagans: And St. Mesrop, the order of Repentance. St. Movses the poet: the Lamplighting (Jrakalooyts), 'Rejoice', the order of the Nativity and 'Unfading'; the Presentation of the Lord, the first of the Dormition, the Verses (Harts) of the Resurrection, and the first image of the Coming of the Spirit, those of Vartavar and of the Dormition, and 'Let Us Magnify'. And those of St. Anthony, of the Kings, of the Apostles, of John, of St. Gregory, of the Prophets, and of the Vartanank: all of these some attribute to the house of Ananias, and some to Khorenatsi. Lord Komitas: the 'Souls' [?] of the Hripsimeans, and the Verses. St. Isaac Dzoraporetsi, who went against the Turks: the hymns of the Cross, of the Church, of the Spotless Living-Image, and 'Lord of Heaven'; he adorned the Blessings. Gregory the Magistros: the 'Four according to the Image', which others attribute to the house of Sahak Dzoraporetsi. St. Nerses Shnorhali: the [?] voice of the Great Blessings, those of the Seventy, of the Ninevites, of the [?] of all Sundays, of the Verses of Palm Sunday, and the four images of Pentecost; the two images of Vartavar, and the two images of the Dormition; the [?] verses of John; the [?] verses of the Prophets; those of the Archangels, the Newly-Wondrous Vartan, those of the Ghevontyank, and 'Today, the Ineffable', 'The Renewer', 'God Uncreated', 'The Creator', the Sharagans of the Dawn, 'We Bless You'; 'Today, the Ineffable', 'The Creator', 'God Uncreated'; and according to some, those of St. James too are said to be his. 17. Nerses Lambronatsi: 'Today He Rose', 'The Renewed Islands', that of the Ascension and that of the Grandsons. Gregory Skevratsi: 'The Sun of Righteousness', of St. John the Baptist. Vardan the Great Vardapet: 'Who Foreknew', 'From the Boundless Sea', the Blessing of the Translators 'Who Adorned', and the Blessing of St. Sarkis 'Of the All-Holy Trinity'. Hovhannes Vardapet Plouz: of St. Nerses 'Who the Ineffable Light', 'Today the Rejoicing', and 'All the Mountains' [?] of the holy Illuminator; and 'In the Last Days'. Kirakos Vardapet Yerznkatsi: 'The Surpassingly Radiant East', which some give to Kirakos Eznkatsi, who was a disciple of Gregory the Great Martyr-Lover. 'New Zion' [cut off]. 'With Blood' [cut off]. The fourth mode of the selection is completed.
